title: Sell Mineral Rights in Evergreen, AL
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Evergreen, AL | Offer
metaDescription: Evergreen, the Conecuh County seat, mineral or royalty owner? We give a clear cash offer built from your real south Alabama lease and production data.
heroLead: Evergreen is both a town and the Conecuh County seat, meaning it is home to a lot of local mineral owners and also where the actual courthouse records establishing ownership across the county are filed.
intro: Because Evergreen sits at the administrative center of Conecuh County, we end up doing courthouse research here regardless of where in the county a specific mineral tract is located. If your family's interest is anywhere in this county, the Conecuh County Probate Office right here in Evergreen likely holds the deed or estate records we need.

sections.heading: Conecuh County's place in the south Alabama trend
paragraphs: Conecuh County sits within the broader south Alabama Smackover and Norphlet trend that has generated leasing and production activity across this region for decades, generally in salt-related structural traps that concentrate production in specific areas rather than spreading it evenly across the county. Some Evergreen-area tracts have real production history; others were leased speculatively during periods of high regional interest and never drilled.
We check your specific legal description against known well and unit records before quoting, since the two situations require very different approaches to valuation.

sections.heading: Doing the courthouse work so you do not have to
paragraphs: Whether your family's interest traces through a will, an unprobated estate, or a straightforward deed, the records that answer those questions for anyone in Conecuh County sit at the courthouse right here in Evergreen. We pull deed history, check for existing leases, and confirm current operator information as part of every evaluation.
If your title needs to be cleared before a sale can close, we will tell you exactly what that requires, whether it is a simple heirship affidavit or something more involved.

faqs.question: Since Evergreen is the county seat, does that mean interests here are more valuable?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Being the county seat affects where records are filed, not the underlying geology or production potential of a specific tract.

faqs.question: Where exactly would my Conecuh County deed or estate records be filed?
faqs.answer: At the Conecuh County Probate Office, located right in Evergreen, which serves the entire county.

faqs.question: Is there current oil and gas production near Evergreen?
faqs.answer: Some tracts in this part of Conecuh County have production history tied to the south Alabama Smackover trend, while others do not; we check each specific tract.

faqs.question: What is the fastest way to find out what my family owns here?
faqs.answer: Send us your deed, a lease, or any estate paperwork, and we can research current status directly through the county records.
